14545: Mashiro is a 14-year-old boy who doesn't know what to do with his life. One day his classmate Takagi finds out about his amazing drawing skills and asks him to help create a manga.
14546: Azuki is Mashiro's classmate. Her dream is to be a voice actor. She agreed to marry Mashiro when both of their dreams come true. However, she also told him that in the mean time, they should not have any distractions so they will contact each other only through emails.
14552: Akito is a young 14-year-old who gets some of the best grades in the country and is an award-winning writer.
15445: Moritaka's uncle. He died due to overwork, but Moritaka thought he committed suicide until he saw his work. He uses his pen name Taro Kawaguchi for his works. He liked Miho's mother, but was too late to confess to her.
16596: Eiji Nizuma is a high school genius mangaka who has been drawing ever since he was young. Moritaka Mashiro and Akito Takagi consider him their rival.
17976: Miho's best friend, who is in 9th year, class 2 in the same school as Miho and Mashiro. Though being her best friend, she doesn't know that Miho likes Mashiro.
18914: One of the editors of the Weekly Shōnen Jump. He is a thin, odd-looking man with a wide-eyed gaze and distinctive lips. Hattori Akira was Akito Takagi's and Moritaka Mashiro's editor. He helped them with their names and eventually got them serialized for Detective Trap.
21107: Fukuda is a main supporting character in Bakuman and the founder of Team Fukuda. He left home after high school and worked as an assistant to Eiji Niizuma for Crow, along with Mashiro.
22818: Hiramaru was a salaryman​ that hated working. On hearing Takagi and Mashiro talking about drawing manga on the subway and finding an abandoned copy of Jack, he quit his job to be a mangaka because he thought it would be less work for him.
23480: Miura is the second editor for Ashirogi Muto. He is very enthusiastic and excited, and sometimes not a hard enough editor for the boys.
23481: Koogy is a musician and a fashion designer.
23482: Aoki is a manga creator who used to work for a shoujo magazine called Margaret Magazine​ until she was advised to switch over to a shounen magazine. Over at Shounen Jump, she worked with Nakai on her series Hideout Door.
23483: Nakai is an assistant for Niizuma. He won a monthly award ten years ago and has been determined to get serialized since. He is good with backgrounds and angles.
23485: Yujiro is one of the youngest editors at Shounen Jump and editor of Eiji Nizuma's successful manga Crow as well as Fukuda's, Kiyoshi Knight and later Road Racer Giri. Yujiro has difficulty keeping Eiji in line but prides himself on finding such a talented Mangaka.
23681: She is one of Ashirogi Muto's assistants, along with Takahama and Ogawa. She is their only female assistant. She has one year of experience with shounen and one year of experience with shoujo.
23682: Iwase is an intelligent girl who was a classmate of Mashiro and Takagi during Junior High. Iwase is an academic achiever in school. She's difficult to get along with due to her strict and high-standard nature.
23683: Miyuki Haruno is Miho's mother and the woman Mashiro Nobuhiro loved. She also loved Nobuhiro but could never say it. She later married someone else. She would watch Superhero Legend with Miho when she was younger.
30290: Takahama was one of Ashirogi Muto's assistants, along with Ogawa and Kato, for Detective Trap. He did the figures, both sketches, and inks. Miura said he was the best artist of the new assistants he was in charge of.
31073: Editor-in-Chief of Weekly Jump. He tends to behave indifferently or even coldly but it's all for Jump's authors and editors to regain their spirits. He has a good eye for manga and believes it's most important for a manga to be interesting.
35410: The Assistant Editor-in-Chief at Shueisha's Weekly Shōnen Jump.
37252: Orihara is a young assistant who worked with Ashirogi Muto on "Run, Daihatsu Tanto!". He is a very energetic and cheerful character that tends to get loud due to his excitement, may it be about work or something else.
37580: Masahiro Mashiro is the father of Moritaka Mashiro. He is the older brother of Nobuhiro Mashiro.
37582: Moritaka's grandfather and the father of Masahiro Mashiro and Nobuhiro Mashiro. He is the one who gives Moritaka Nobuhiro's studio key.
37602: Mina is Miho's younger sister. She has black hair in pigtails. Not unlike her family, she has a beautiful face, as noted by Takagi.
37739: Ishizawa attends the same Junior High as Takagi and Mashiro. Ishizawa draws ecchi headshots of girls and brags about it. He later insults Mashiro's drawings. He is a large nuisance to the duo.
38651: Yoshida is Hiramaru Kazuya's editor. He tells the chief-editor in the meeting about his genius, which led to Hiramaru's serialization. He is able to ignore Hiramaru's personality.
38667: Shiratori Shun is an assistant for Ashirogi Muto's Perfect Crime Party and the mangaka of Rabuta & Peace. Shiratori comes from a wealthy family and has a sister.
38891: Japanese rock musician, HYDE, makes his voice acting debut playing himself. He is the producer for an artist named Koogy.
40127: Kosugi is a newly hired editor at Jump. He does not have much experience as an editor and is assigned to be Nanamine Tooru's editor. He is around 23 or 24 years old. Kosugi sports chin-length black hair and thick-framed glasses.
40128: Nanamine Tooru is a newcomer mangaka. He has been a fan of Ashirogi Muto since their early days, even going so far as to sending them fan letters periodically, voicing his opinions on their various manga. He seems cheerful, sociable, and easy to talk to.
41426: Nakai and Aoki Ko's editor. He is also a Captain, meaning he gets to sit in on the serialization meetings.
41477: Masakazu Yamahisa is Ryu Shizuka and later, Ko Aoki's editor. He works with Ryo to get mis manga more Weekly Shōnen Jump friendly and offers Aoki to work on a manga with romance in it suitable for the magazine.
45801: Arai is a mangaka who is serialized in Jump. His manga debuted in the issue of Jump before Detective Trap. It is called Cheese Okaki. He used to work as an assistant for Mikihiko Azuma. Arai is friendly, mostly getting along well with whoever he meets.
45923: The mangaka of Great Thief Cheater.
45927: Yosshi Miyoshi is Kaya Miyoshi's father. He is a real estate agent and a karate teacher. In 1st, 2nd, 5th, 6th grade, and most of Jr. high and high school, he was in the same class as Moritaka's uncle Nobuhiro, and they were best friends.
45929: Ogawa is one of Ashirogi Muto's assistants, along with Kato and Takahama for Detective Trap. He is the head assistant and does the backgrounds. Ogawa has a wife and child.
45933: Yasuoka is Fukuda Shinta's assistant for his series Kiyoshi Knight. He helps Fukuda come up with ideas, and for every good idea he comes up with Fukuda says he will pay Yasuoka 3000 yen. He and Fukuda get along well. He is a young man with a red mohawk and ear peircings.
45935: An editor at Shueisha's Weekly Shounen Jump.
49467: Kazuhiko Torishima is a member of Jump's Board of Directors and was a former editor-in-chief of Weekly Shonen Jump. Like other editors shown in the Bakuman series, he bears a distinctive resemblance to his real-life counterpart.
56883: Kaya Miyoshi's mother. Anime debut: Bakuman 2 episode 19 (Fate and Star)
74852: One of the voice actresses of "Saint Visual Girls Academy" who sings the ending song with Miho Azuki.
74854: One of the voice actresses of "Saint Visual Girls Academy" who sings the ending song with Miho Azuki
